title: Pidakkozhi Koovunna Noottandu
overview: The story revolves around a paying guest home run by Chinthamani Ammal who is a determined man-hater due to a failed love affair. Only man-haters are allowed as paying guests. Ponnamma hates men because of her parents being partial to her twin brother Ponnappan. Another guest, Nancy, is a lawyer and is engaged on a post divorce custody battle for the child with Tony Varghese. Rudra and Bhagyarekha pretend to be man-haters to please Chinthamani Ammal.  The story is about how each of the women finds true life partner.

songs.title: Muttukaran
songs.singers: Jagathy, K. S. Chithra, Sindhu, Sujatha Mohan, Urvashi
